logp.method_description: The partition coefficients (Log D, pH 7.4) of [⁹⁹ᵐTc]Tc(CO)₃-8 and [⁹⁹ᵐTc]Tc(CO)₃-12 were determined using the shake-flask method. Briefly, 10 µL (~ 10 MBq) of each radioligand was added to a biphasic system consisting of 1-octanol (500 µL) and phosphate-buffered saline (PBS, 490 µL, pH 7.4). The mixtures were vortex-mixed for 15 min to ensure complete equilibration between the organic and aqueous phases, resulting in the formation of a milky emulsion. The samples were subsequently centrifuged at 8000 rpm for 15 min to achieve phase separation. Following centrifugation, 10 µL aliquots were collected from each phase, and their radioactivity was measured using a gamma counter. All experiments were performed in triplicate. The Log D values at pH 7.4 for [⁹⁹ᵐTc]Tc(CO)₃-8 and [⁹⁹ᵐTc]Tc(CO)₃-12 were calculated according to Log D pH 7.4 = Log[(organic phase count)/( PBS pH 7.4 count)].
